IMDb Top 250 Rated Video Games

Here is a list of the top 250 games (unofficial), rated by IMDb users.
  • Note that remastered editions, trilogy/compilation packs, enhanced versions, or similar releases are not included in this list. Only original standalone games and significantly different remakes or similar ones are considered. However, please note that the list may not be completely accurate, as I'm not certain every game listed belongs here or that I haven’t missed any.
  • Only games with at least 1000 votes have been included.
  • The list is ranked from highest to lowest as of April 10, 2026. It's also important to note that when you sort games by IMDb ratings, titles with the same rating are actually sorted by popularity and not by official rank. Within each rating, games are sorted alphabetically here. I think this is a better option than ordering them at random. Red Dead Redemption II (2018) is confirmed as the true number one.
  • Games released in 2026 won’t be included until the year is over.


I hope you find this list helpful. Happy gaming!
Created byprolelol
